name: Smoky Salmon-Coconut Rice Bowl with Cucumber, Mango & Yogurt Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
3 mangoes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, juice limes into a small bowl. Add yogurt and chili-garlic sauce, then stir to combine the spicy yogurt sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add salmon (with marinade) and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the mango (reserving a small handful for serving) and stir to combine.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, pickled cucumber, and mango between bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce, top with reserved cilantro, and enjoy!
